name: Consume Magic
body:
You can metabolize the magic you prepare to infuse your blood with sorcerous power.

Prerequisite(s): Blood pool

Benefit(s): You gain the following ways to gain blood points:

As a free action once per round you may expend one spell slot to gain a number of blood points equal to twice its spell level, or expend up to 1 spell point per 4 caster levels (minimum 1) to gain four times that many blood points.
As a free action once per round you may consume a scroll or 2 charges from a wand to gain a number of blood points equal to the level of the spell contained in the item. The item must have a caster level at least equal to 1 per 4 legendary bloodrager levels you have (minimum 1).
